item.title: Mars in Virgo: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Mars in Virgo means Mars was in Virgo when you were born. In astrology Mars stands for your drive and energy; Virgo is an earth sign ruled by Mercury, precise and careful. Your effort is quiet, exact, and relentless. Read more at astralroots.app
